purpose: Define a machine-checkable external operation history and sink journal for SRQ delivery qualification.
transaction_atomicity_contract: Each transaction journal record binds one idempotency key and request digest to exactly one effect ID and one durable receipt ID; it is the sink's atomic commit record, not an inferred join of independent tables.
ordering_contract: commit_seq and fence event_seq share one sink-controlled durable sequence domain; all values are unique. Fencing advances must be strictly increasing and every transaction must use the currently effective token when fencing_required is true.
required_checks: successful operations bind to a committed transaction with identical key and request digest
successful operations return the exact effect ID and receipt ID of that transaction
each committed transaction contains both effect and receipt IDs
one idempotency key cannot commit multiple transactions
retries for the same key and intent return stable transaction/effect/receipt identities
reusing a key with different intent cannot succeed
mismatch rejection does not have an effect for the rejected intent
fencing events are monotonic and effect commits use the currently effective token
limitations: does not authenticate the sink journal or prove trace completeness
does not prove storage durability or atomicity independently of the sink implementation
does not implement a full linearizability checker
does not measure retention-window expiry, anchor independence, or recovery liveness
passing a synthetic fixture is not production evidence
